company.name: CoLab Software
company.shortDescription: CoLab Software develops modern collaboration technologies for the mechanical design industry.
company.description: CoLab is a Design Engagement System that helps engineering teams make better technical decisions, faster. By combining AI-powered design checks with real-time collaboration, CoLab turns every review into structured, searchable knowledge database. Over time, that knowledge becomes fuel for AI agents that prevent repeat mistakes and surface lessons learned when they matter most. It’s how engineering teams scale good decisions across people, programs, and time.

aiResearchSummary.text: CoLab Software is engaged in research and development of multi-user collaboration systems for the mechanical design industry. The work focuses on creating a workspace where multiple users can share digital materials, as described in 'Multi-User Collaboration Systems, and Methods of Providing Thereof.' The approach includes methods for internal and external user participation, supporting collaborative workflows. These efforts highlight advancements in collaborative digital environments for design teams.
